# ETL Extraction Contract

**This file is auto-generated** from `backend/src/modules/analytics/domain/extraction_contract.py`. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate with:

```bash
cd backend && .venv/bin/python scripts/generate_extraction_contract_doc.py
```

The contract is the single source of truth for what the analytics ETL extracts, from where, when, and where it lands. It is enforced by `backend/tests/architecture/test_extraction_contract.py` — that test fails if the providers in `PROVIDER_REGISTRY` drift from the entries here.

## Why this exists

Future Claude (or any developer / auditor) should be able to answer:

1. **Which external sources do we pull from?**
2. **What metrics does each provider produce?**
3. **When does the extraction run?**
4. **Where does the data land?**
5. **What is currently broken or partial?**

...without having to read every provider implementation.

## Storage tables

These are the tables the ETL pipeline reads or writes. Generated by `pipeline.py` / `period_pipeline.py` / `campaign_sync_pipeline.py`.

| Table | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `staging_metrics` | Raw extracted rows before deduplication & promotion to official. One row per (extraction_run, channel, metric, day). Wiped at the start of every run for that (tenant, provider) pair. |
| `official_metrics` | Authoritative daily metrics. Natural key: (tenant_id, provider, channel_slug, metric_name, metric_date). Upserted from staging via ON CONFLICT. |
| `metric_aggregations` | Pre-computed rollups: daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, last_30_days. Replaced wholesale per (tenant, channel) at the end of each run. |
| `period_metrics` | NON_AGGREGABLE metrics (reach, users, frequency, repeat_customers, ig_accounts_engaged, meta_video_avg_watch_time) extracted per weekly/monthly/quarterly bucket. These cannot be summed across days. |
| `extraction_runs` | Audit log of every ETL invocation. Tracks status, duration, metrics_count, rows_extracted, sub_extractor_failures, rate_limit_headroom, period_start/end, extraction_type. |
| `ad_campaigns` | Meta Ads campaign hierarchy snapshot. Populated by ``run_campaign_sync`` (separate from metrics extraction). |
| `ad_sets` | Meta ad set hierarchy snapshot. |
| `ads` | Meta individual ads + creative snapshot. |
| `ad_recommendations` | Meta-suggested optimizations per object. |
| `channel_cost_settings` | User-configured manual costs (e.g. agency fees). NOT populated by the ETL — written from the Connections UI. |
| `journey_events` | Customer event timeline. Populated by inbound webhooks (Shopify checkout/order, Manychat dm/comment, Mailerlite open/click). The ``crm_internal`` provider reads from this table for cold-contact metrics. |

## `channel_type` → providers (intended mapping)

This is the mapping that `etl_service.run_all_providers` SHOULD use to resolve which provider handles each `channel_connections.channel_type` value. It is currently NOT applied — the code uses `conn.channel_type` directly which silently ignores any connection whose `channel_type` does not equal a provider name verbatim.

| `channel_type` | Provider(s) |
|---|---|
| `meta` | `meta` |
| `facebook_page` | `meta` |
| `instagram_account` | `meta` |
| `meta_ads_account` | `meta` |
| `meta_pixel` | `meta_pixel` |
| `google_analytics` | `google_analytics`, `search_console` |
| `google_ads` | `google_ads` |
| `search_console` | `search_console` |
| `youtube` | `youtube` |
| `youtube_analytics` | `youtube` |
| `tiktok` | `tiktok` |
| `tiktok_ads` | `tiktok` |
| `shopify` | `shopify` |
| `mailerlite` | `mailerlite` |
| `mailchimp` | `mailerlite` |
| `activecampaign` | `mailerlite` |
| `manychat` | `manychat` |

## Worker schedule reference

Source: `backend/src/workers/settings.py`. The contract test verifies that the function names referenced here still exist.

| Task | Schedule |
|---|---|
| `run_tick_scheduler` | Every minute. Walks every active tenant; if its local time is exactly 03:00, enqueues run_tenant_extraction(tenant_id, 'all') + run_campaign_sync(tenant_id, 'meta'). Also detects weekly/monthly/quarterly period boundaries and enqueues run_period_extraction for each. |
| `run_tenant_extraction` | Triggered by run_tick_scheduler at 03:00 local. Calls ETLService.run_all_providers which iterates active connections and invokes the right provider per channel_type. |
| `run_campaign_sync` | Triggered by run_tick_scheduler. Currently hardcoded to provider='meta'. Refreshes ad_campaigns/ad_sets/ads/ad_recommendations via MetaCampaignProvider. |
| `run_period_extraction` | Triggered by run_tick_scheduler when a week/month/quarter boundary is hit, OR manually via the script in this repo. Calls ETLService.run_period_extraction which iterates connections that have has_period_extraction()=True and writes to period_metrics. |
| `run_initial_load` | Triggered by the Connections UI on first connect, or manually via ARQ enqueue. Loads up to ETLConfig.MAX_LOOKBACK_DAYS (currently 90) of historical data. |
| `run_mailerlite_etl_sync` | Independent cron — every 6 hours at :15 (00:15, 06:15, 12:15, 18:15 UTC). Refreshes Mailerlite outside the daily 3am window. |
| `run_inactivity_detection` | Daily at 04:00 UTC. CRM scoring batch. |
| `run_frozen_detection` | Every 4 hours at :30 (00:30, 04:30, ..., 20:30 UTC). Sales agent frozen-conversation detector. |
| `cleanup_old_events` | Daily at 03:30 UTC. Trims old copilot events. |
| `poll_domain_verification` | Every 5 minutes. Polls Cloudflare for tenant_domains DNS status. |

# Provider details

## `crm_internal` — CRM Internal (cold contact metrics from journey_events)

**Status:** 🔴 broken  
**Code:** `src.modules.analytics.infrastructure.providers.crm_internal_provider.CRMInternalProvider`  
**Auth:** internal via Reads our own DB via credentials['db_session']  
**Required credentials:** `db_session`  
**Serves channel_types:** _none_  
**Multi-stage:** no  
**Stages supported:** `attraction`  
**Has period extraction:** no  
**Extraction modes:** internal_db  
**Cron:** Would run daily but is currently never invoked  
**Storage tables:** `staging_metrics`, `official_metrics`, `metric_aggregations`  
**Last verified:** 2026-04-11

### API endpoints

_None — does not call any external API._

### Channels & metrics

#### Channel `cold-contact` (stage: `attraction`)

Counts of outbound contact attempts and responses from journey_events with event_name in {outbound_contact, outbound_call, outbound_email} and {outbound_response, outbound_reply}.

| Canonical name | API field | Unit | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `contacts` | `count(OUTBOUND_CONTACT_EVENTS)` | count | |
| `responses` | `count(OUTBOUND_RESPONSE_EVENTS)` | count | |

### Known issues

- BROKEN: requires credentials['db_session'] but neither etl_service.run_all_providers nor pipeline.py ever passes a DB session through credentials. The provider returns an empty result and logs a warning. As a result, cold-contact metrics never land in official_metrics. Fix requires either passing the session via pipeline context or refactoring to a separate extraction path that does not go through ConnectionPort.
- There is no row in channel_connections for crm_internal, so even if the bug above were fixed, run_all_providers would not discover it. It needs to be invoked as a special case.

### Known issues

- Multi-stage orchestration is sequential within run_extraction. If stage A passes and stage B fails, the run row reports the status of B and the data from A is not rolled back. There is no single run that summarizes all stages.
- Campaign-type classification is keyword-based (Spanish + English) and falls back to 'attraction' for unknown names.

## `manychat` — Manychat (webhook-fed pass-through)

**Status:** ⚪ pass-through  
**Code:** `src.modules.analytics.infrastructure.providers.manychat_provider.ManyChatProvider`  
**Auth:** internal via None — data arrives via webhooks  
**Required credentials:** _none_  
**Serves channel_types:** `manychat`  
**Multi-stage:** no  
**Stages supported:** `capture`  
**Has period extraction:** no  
**Extraction modes:** webhook_ingested  
**Cron:** No cron pull. Data arrives via Manychat webhooks (see modules/connections marketing_webhooks.py). The extract_metrics method is a no-op so the scheduler can include this provider in cache invalidation flows.

_None — does not call any external API._

### Channels & metrics

#### Channel `manychat` (stage: `capture`)

Conversational entry points (DM triggers, comment triggers). Metric values are written by webhook handlers, not by this provider.

_No metrics emitted directly — populated via webhooks or downstream._

## `meta` — Meta (Facebook + Instagram + Meta Ads)

**Status:** 🟡 partial  
**Code:** `src.modules.analytics.infrastructure.providers.meta_provider.MetaProvider`  
**Auth:** long_lived_token via Meta Graph API (system user token)  
**Required credentials:** `access_token`, `ads_account_id`, `instagram_business_account_id`, `page_id`  
**Serves channel_types:** `meta`, `facebook_page`, `instagram_account`, `meta_ads_account`  
**Multi-stage:** no  
**Stages supported:** `attraction`  
**Has period extraction:** yes  
**Extraction modes:** daily_etl, initial_load, period_backfill  
**Cron:** Daily at 03:00 tenant-local time via run_tick_scheduler. Period extraction also enqueued at week/month/quarter boundaries.  
**Storage tables:** `staging_metrics`, `official_metrics`, `metric_aggregations`, `period_metrics`  
**Last verified:** 2026-04-11

> Extracts daily ad-level metrics with time_increment=1 to avoid the contamination bug where a single aggregated row polluted the last day of the period (Visionarias incident, see PeriodAggregateError docstring).

### API endpoints

- **Meta Ads insights with day-level breakdown** ([docs](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/insights))
  `https://graph.facebook.com/v24.0/act_{ads_account_id}/insights`
- **Instagram organic insights (period=day, ≤30d chunks)** ([docs](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-api/reference/ig-user/insights))
  `https://graph.facebook.com/v24.0/{ig_user_id}/insights`
- **Instagram media count + profile metadata**
  `https://graph.facebook.com/v24.0/{ig_user_id}`
- **Facebook page insights (organic)** ([docs](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/reference/page/insights/))
  `https://graph.facebook.com/v24.0/{page_id}/insights`

See ETL audit 2026-04-11.
